recognize_zh: 骨髓中除 CD34+ 母細胞外，還有許多中型、圓核、染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍且邊緣有小空泡的漿細胞樣單核細胞（箭頭）；免疫染色 CD34 標出母細胞，CD123 另標出成群陽性細胞但 TCL1 陰性，符合伴隨漿細胞樣樹突細胞增加的急性骨髓性白血病（pDC-AML）。
features: Peripheral blood: circulating blasts and atypical mononuclear cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm (arrows), with background neutrophils

Bone marrow aspirate: hypercellular with increased blasts and a prominent population of medium-sized plasmacytoid mononuclear cells with eccentric round nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm bearing small peripheral vacuoles (arrows)
Background dysplastic-appearing granulocytic and erythroid elements
Core biopsy: markedly hypercellular marrow replaced by sheets of monotonous immature mononuclear cells
IHC: CD34-positive blasts; CD123 highlights a separate, clustered population of pDCs; TCL1 is largely negative
describe_en: The peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts and atypical plasmacytoid mononuclear cells with fine chromatin and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm. The bone marrow aspirate is hypercellular with increased blasts and a conspicuous population of medium-sized plasmacytoid cells with round eccentric nuclei and agranular grey-blue cytoplasm containing small peripheral vacuoles. The core biopsy is markedly hypercellular with sheets of immature mononuclear cells. Immunohistochemistry shows numerous CD34-positive blasts and a separate, clustered CD123-positive plasmacytoid dendritic cell population that is largely TCL1-negative. In the setting of prior MDS with ASXL1/SRSF2 mutations, findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with increased plasmacytoid dendritic cells (pDC-AML).

ddx.vs: In BPDCN the neoplastic cells are CD34-negative blasts coexpressing CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCL1, whereas here CD34+ myeloid blasts are accompanied by a separate, mostly TCL1-negative and CD56-negative CD123+ pDC population.

ddx.dx: Chronic myelomonocytic leukemia with pDC nodules
ddx.vs: CMML with pDC nodules has persistent monocytosis and <20% blasts, while this marrow shows increased CD34+ blasts reaching the AML threshold.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei and express CD14/CD11c/lysozyme without the bright CD123+, CD303+ plasmacytoid cells in clusters.
Blast count below 20% separates MDS-IB, requiring careful counting because pDCs are not included in the blast percentage.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD34, CD123, TCL1
captions: Peripheral blood smear: circulating blasts and atypical plasmacytoid mononuclear cells (arrows)
Bone marrow aspirate: hypercellular with blasts and plasmacytoid cells (arrow)
Bone marrow aspirate, high power: plasmacytoid dendritic cells with grey-blue cytoplasm and peripheral vacuoles (arrows)
Core biopsy H&E: markedly hypercellular marrow with sheets of immature cells
IHC: CD34-positive blasts, clustered CD123-positive pDCs, and largely negative TCL1
